question: Using the Human Protein Atlas, study all FDA approved drug-target genes with strictly positive consensus RNA nTPM and tissue mass-spectrometry Intensity in both kidney and colon. Report the initial drug-target count and the number retained after each measurement requirement. For retained genes calculate log2(kidney/colon) separately for RNA and protein; give their Spearman correlation and counts in the four positive/negative direction combinations, reporting exact-zero changes separately. Rank the twelve largest absolute differences between the RNA and protein log2 ratios. Give their Ensembl IDs, symbols, four measurements, both ratios, secretome location and main subcellular locations. Draw an RNA-versus-protein fold-change scatter, a direction-count bar chart and a heatmap of those twelve genes' two fold changes; provide the plotted data. Break ranking ties by Ensembl ID. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

{"query": "WITH druggies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Ensembl FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE POSITION('FDA approved drug targets' IN ' ' || "Protein class" || ' ') > 0
),
rna AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) AS ntpm_kidney,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='colon'  THEN TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) AS ntpm_colon
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus
  WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon')
  GROUP BY "Gene"
),
ms AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) END) AS i_kidney,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='colon'  THEN TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) END) AS i_colon
  FROM ms_tissue
  WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon')
  GROUP BY "Gene"
)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM druggies) AS initial_drug_targets,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM druggies d JOIN rna r ON r."Gene"=d.Ensembl
   WHERE r.ntpm_kidney>0 AND r.ntpm_colon>0) AS after_rna,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM druggies d JOIN rna r ON r."Gene"=d.Ensembl
   JOIN ms m ON m."Gene"=d.Ensembl
   WHERE r.ntpm_kidney>0 AND r.ntpm_colon>0
     AND m.i_kidney>0 AND m.i_colon>0) AS retained"}

{"query": "WITH druggies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Ensembl, "Gene" AS sym FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE POSITION('FDA approved drug targets' IN ' ' || "Protein class" || ' ') > 0
),
rna AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) AS ntpm_kidney,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='colon'  THEN TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) AS ntpm_colon
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
ms AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) END) AS i_kidney,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='colon'  THEN TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) END) AS i_colon
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
ret AS (
  SELECT d.Ensembl, d.sym, r.ntpm_kidney, r.ntpm_colon, m.i_kidney, m.i_colon,
    LOG2(r.ntpm_kidney / r.ntpm_colon) AS rna_fc,
    LOG2(m.i_kidney / m.i_colon) AS prot_fc,
    ABS(LOG2(r.ntpm_kidney / r.ntpm_colon) - LOG2(m.i_kidney / m.i_colon)) AS adiff
  FROM druggies d
  JOIN rna r ON r."Gene"=d.Ensembl
  JOIN ms  m ON m."Gene"=d.Ensembl
  WHERE r.ntpm_kidney>0 AND r.ntpm_colon>0 AND m.i_kidney>0 AND m.i_colon>0
)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret) AS n,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc>0 AND prot_fc>0) AS both_pos,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc>0 AND prot_fc<0) AS rna_pos_prot_neg,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc<0 AND prot_fc>0) AS rna_neg_prot_pos,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc<0 AND prot_fc<0) AS both_neg,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc=0) AS rna_exact_zero,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE prot_fc=0) AS prot_exact_zero,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc=0 AND prot_fc=0) AS both_exact_zero,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ret WHERE rna_fc<>0 AND prot_fc<>0) AS nonzero_both"}

  FROM ms_tissue WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
pts AS (
  SELECT d.sym,
    LOG2(r.nk / r.nc) AS rna_fc,
    LOG2(m.ik / m.ic) AS prot_fc
  FROM druggies d
  JOIN rna r ON r."Gene"=d.Ensembl JOIN ms m ON m."Gene"=d.Ensembl
  WHERE r.nk>0 AND r.nc>0 AND m.ik>0 AND m.ic>0
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT LEAST(41, GREATEST(0, FLOOR((rna_fc + 9.5)/0.5))) AS bx,
         LEAST(18, GREATEST(0, FLOOR((prot_fc + 6.5)/0.7))) AS by,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sym IN ('DBH','PLG','CA1','ABCC1','ALB','JAK1','CA4','FGB','CPS1','MTTP','NNMT','TNNC1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_top12,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM pts GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT yv AS yrow,
  STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN ' '
                  WHEN is_top12 = 1 THEN 'O'
                  WHEN n = 1 THEN '+'
                  WHEN n = 2 THEN 'o'
                  ELSE '#' END, '' ORDER BY xv) AS plot
FROM (SELECT UNNEST(RANGE(0,19)) AS yv) yy
CROSS JOIN (SELECT UNNEST(RANGE(0,42)) AS xv) xx
LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.bx=xx.xv AND cnt.by=yy.yv
GROUP BY yv ORDER BY yv DESC"}

WITH druggies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Ensembl, "Gene" AS sym FROM proteinatlas
  WHERE POSITION('FDA approved drug targets' IN ' ' || "Protein class" || ' ') > 0
),
rna AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) AS nk,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='colon'  THEN TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) AS nc
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
ms AS (
  SELECT "Gene",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='kidney' THEN TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) END) AS ik,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Tissue='colon'  THEN TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE) END) AS ic
  FROM ms_tissue WHERE Tissue IN ('kidney','colon') GROUP BY "Gene"
),
pts AS (
  SELECT d.sym,
    LOG2(r.nk / r.nc) AS rna_fc,
    LOG2(m.ik / m.ic) AS prot_fc
  FROM druggies d
  JOIN rna r ON r."Gene"=d.Ensembl JOIN ms m ON m."Gene"=d.Ensembl
  WHERE r.nk>0 AND r.nc>0 AND m.ik>0 AND m.ic>0
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT LEAST(41, GREATEST(0, FLOOR((rna_fc + 9.5)/0.5))) AS bx,
         LEAST(18, GREATEST(0, FLOOR((prot_fc + 6.5)/0.7))) AS by,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sym IN ('DBH','PLG','CA1','ABCC1','ALB','JAK1','CA4','FGB','CPS1','MTTP','NNMT','TNNC1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_top12,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM pts GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT yv AS yrow,
  STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN n IS NULL THEN ' '
                  WHEN is_top12 = 1 THEN 'O'
                  WHEN n = 1 THEN '+'
                  WHEN n = 2 THEN 'o'
                  ELSE '#' END, '' ORDER BY xv) AS plot
FROM (SELECT UNNEST(RANGE(0,19)) AS yv) yy
CROSS JOIN (SELECT UNNEST(RANGE(0,42)) AS xv) xx
LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.bx=xx.xv AND cnt.by=yy.yv
GROUP BY yv ORDER BY yv DESC
